deltaCorrection.label: Delta correction (ZoomRx PCA house method)
deltaCorrection.note: Weighted shares are held within 5 percentage points of unweighted. Per cell, the largest gap sets one factor f = min(1, target / largest gap), and every weighted share is moved f of the way from unweighted toward weighted. Cells already inside the target are untouched.

volTreatments.label: Mean + 3SD cap (S0.80 fence)
volTreatments.note: Deliverable method. Outliers identified on the eligible volume that weights the shares — S0.80 stage 3+4 in each indication (CRC 3 MDs, BTC 4 MDs). That total is capped at mean+3SD; everyone else stands as reported.

volTreatments.label: Median replacement
volTreatments.note: Superseded. All 12 volume fields replaced with the retained-sample median.

volTreatments.label: Mean + 3SD cap (S0.70 fence)
volTreatments.note: Outliers identified on S0.70 total patient volume (6 MDs). Values above the retained-sample mean+3SD are capped at it; values below it stand as reported.
